customer_name: Kaoshibao (Shanghai Juxian Network Technology Co., Ltd.)
business_problem: Kaoshibao needed to use new AI interaction and content technologies to improve personalized learning, lower content-production costs, and make very large question banks easier to ingest, search, and explain.
solution_summary: Kaoshibao used Baidu AI Cloud's Qianfan platform to turn a large exam-content operation into an AI-native learning and content-production pipeline. Qianfan ModelBuilder supplied the large-model capabilities behind question generation, explanation, key-point extraction, and multimodal recognition, while Qianfan AppBuilder assembled the user workflows for photo question search, AI question import, and the learning assistant. Uploaded Word, PDF, and image files pass through multimodal recognition to extract text and numbers, then are normalized into structured question-bank assets with deduplication, subject tagging, question-type classification, and difficulty grouping. An Intelligent Search and Generation Component grounds explanations on Baidu question-bank, Wenku, and Baike sources, while Video Understanding Technology turns long lessons into concise notes and knowledge maps that feed tutoring, search, and paid learning services.

solution_components.name: Qianfan ModelBuilder
solution_components.role: Provides the large-model capabilities for question generation, explanation, key-point extraction, and AI-assisted tutoring.

solution_components.name: Qianfan AppBuilder
solution_components.role: Assembles the user-facing workflows for photo question search, AI question import, and the learning assistant.

solution_components.name: Intelligent Search and Generation Component
solution_components.role: Grounds answer explanations on trusted content sources and returns richer search and explanation results.

solution_components.name: Video Understanding Technology
solution_components.role: Turns long-form course videos into concise notes and knowledge maps for faster study consumption.

solution_components.name: Multimodal Recognition
solution_components.role: Extracts text and numbers from uploaded documents and images so they can be structured into reusable question-bank assets.

data_flow: Users upload Word, PDF, and image files or submit photo and video learning queries into Qianfan AppBuilder workflows. Multimodal Recognition extracts and structures question content, Qianfan ModelBuilder generates answers, explanations, and key points, the Intelligent Search and Generation Component grounds those outputs on Baidu content sources, and Video Understanding Technology produces condensed notes and knowledge maps that flow back into Kaoshibao's question-bank and tutoring experiences.
business_outcome: Kaoshibao cut labor and content-production costs, improved search and explanation quality, boosted course completion and pass rates, and increased paid conversion with new AI learning features.
metrics: Text and numerical recognition accuracy approached 100%.
Labor costs fell as much as 99.8%.
Objective-question parsing handles 8 million requests per day.
A 2-hour video lesson can be condensed into 15 minutes of notes and a knowledge map.
